snippet.title: [Xtrhme] Halcyon | Master 12 | S+ Rank (v0.5.1.25)
snippet.description:
Xtrhme is currently in Pre-release phase. Only those who entered the Internal Beta test can play this version. Those who didn't join can wait for the release version instead. This pre-release version added more songs to the songlist with Halcyon is one of them

| *_Description_* |
Xtrhme is a rhythm game where chart constantly switching between 2 play modes (tunnels): FallinK which is a 4K VSRG mode and CentorE which is a 4K circular mode (2 each side). With Ori and Gend in an adventure- wait there is no story yet so idk how will it goes 😅 Enjoy a rich library of songs with dedicated BGA for each. This game is a commercial game by InfinoVation

| *_Game Details_* |
Game: Xtrhme
Version: 0.5.1.25

Song: Halcyon - xi
